hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command? // ""' | grep -Eq '(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])[.]env' && { echo 'Blocked by project hook: .env files hold secrets and must never be read, written, or echoed by Claude.' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

jq -r '[.tool_input.file_path? // "", .tool_input.path? // "", .tool_input.pattern? // ""] | join(" ")' | grep -Eq '(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])[.]env' && { echo 'Blocked by project hook: .env files hold secrets and are off-limits to Claude.' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
